what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2671560 Afghan refugees, and Pakistan hosts the largest share, 43.4%, followed by Iran.
Germany, France and the United Kingdom are the next largest hosts.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1978 to 2025, with opponents over that span that include the PDPA, Hizb-i Islami-yi Afghanistan and the Taleban.
UCDP also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025, and an interstate armed conflict between Afghanistan and Pakistan in 2024 and 2025.

when.text: The number of Afghan refugees peaked at 6403144 in 2023 and fell to 2671560 by the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1981 to 1993, 2000 to 2001 and 2022 to 2024.
Large changes appear between 2021 and 2022 and again between 2024 and 2025.

how.text: From 2025, UNHCR also counts some Afghans as other people in need of international protection, a separate series that is not added to the refugee figures.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
